title: [UI suggestion] Move bolus total line to top in calculator
body: When inputting carbs in calculator using the +/- buttons, the line with the total bolus is obstructed by my hand. I suggest moving it to the top of the dialog.

comments.body: could you attach screenshot and mark it?
I think most calculators got the result @ top of screen.  Mostly so you don't cover the result while typing. I'm positive to this change

You can close this issue as it has been implemented in Dev.
